title: Concussion in Sport — Recognise, Remove and Return Gradually

hook.en: A player takes a knock to the head in a match and says "I'm fine". Is it safe to let them carry on? Concussion is a brain injury that often looks mild but can be dangerous if missed. Learn to recognise it, when to send someone to hospital, and the step-by-step return to play.
hook.ur: Khilari ko match mein sar par chot lagti hai aur woh kehta hai "main theek hoon". Kya usay khelne dena mehfooz hai? Concussion dimagh ki chot hai jo aksar halki lagti hai magar chhoot jaye to khatarnak ho sakti hai. Isay pehchanna, kab hospital bhejna hai, aur khel mein qadam ba qadam wapsi seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll recognise concussion signs and symptoms, identify red flags that need emergency care, explain why a player must not return the same day, and guide a graded return to learning and to sport.
goal.ur: End tak aap concussion ki alamaat aur nishaniyan pehchanenge, emergency care wale red flags dhoondenge, samjhayenge ke khilari usi din wapas kyun nahi aa sakta, aur parhai aur khel mein darje war wapsi ki rehnumai karenge.

text.en: **Concussion** is a brain injury caused by a blow to the head or body that shakes the brain. It usually **does not show on a CT or MRI scan**. Signs include being dazed, slow to get up, unsteady, confused or briefly losing consciousness; symptoms include **headache, dizziness, nausea, blurred vision, feeling "foggy"** and sleep or mood changes. The rule is **"if in doubt, sit them out"**: any player with a suspected concussion must stop and **must not return on the same day**. After **24 to 48 hours of relative rest**, light activity that does not make symptoms much worse is encouraged, then a **graded return** step by step.
text.ur: **Concussion** sar ya jism par chot se hone wali dimagh ki chot hai jo dimagh ko hila deti hai. Yeh aam taur par **CT ya MRI scan mein nazar nahi aati**. Nishaniyon mein madhosh hona, uthne mein der, dagmagana, uljhan ya thori der ke liye hosh khona shamil hain; alamaat mein **sar dard, chakkar, matli, dhundli nazar, "dhund" jaisa mehsoos hona** aur neend ya mood ki tabdeeli shamil hain. Usool hai **"shak ho to bitha dein"**: mashkook concussion wala har khilari ruk jaye aur **usi din wapas na aaye**. **24 se 48 ghante ke nisbatan aaram** ke baad aisi halki activity ki himmat dilayi jati hai jo alamaat ko zyada na barhaye, phir qadam ba qadam **darje war wapsi**.

text.en: A concussed brain is like a **phone with a drained battery after a fall**: it still turns on and looks normal, but it runs out of power quickly when you open too many apps. Return to activity is like **charging slowly** and opening one app at a time, checking it does not overheat.
text.ur: Concussion wala dimagh **girne ke baad khatam battery wale phone** jaisa hai: yeh ab bhi on hota hai aur normal lagta hai, magar bohat se apps kholne par jaldi band ho jata hai. Activity mein wapsi **aahista charge karna** aur ek waqt mein ek app kholna hai, check karte hue ke garam na ho.

steps.title: Step 1 — symptom-limited activity
steps.detail: Daily activities that do not provoke symptoms, such as walking at home, after the first 24 to 48 hours. || Qadam 1 — alamaat tak mehdood activity

steps.title: Steps 2 to 3 — aerobic, then sport-specific exercise
steps.detail: Light then moderate aerobic exercise (walking, stationary cycling), then individual running or skill drills without head contact. A mild, brief rise in symptoms is acceptable; stop if they worsen clearly. || Qadam 2 se 3 — aerobic, phir khel ki khaas exercise

steps.title: Steps 4 to 5 — non-contact then full-contact training
steps.detail: Harder non-contact training drills, then, only when free of symptoms and after medical clearance, full-contact practice. || Qadam 4 se 5 — non-contact phir full-contact training

steps.title: Step 6 — return to play
steps.detail: Normal game play. Each step usually takes at least 24 hours, so the full return takes at least about a week, and longer in children and teenagers. Return to school or work comes before full return to sport. || Qadam 6 — khel mein wapsi

question.en: A player is briefly dazed after a head clash but says he feels fine after 5 minutes. What should happen?
question.ur: Sar takrane ke baad khilari thori der madhosh hota hai magar 5 minute baad kehta hai woh theek hai. Kya hona chahiye?

text.en: Remove him from play for the rest of the day and assess for concussion
text.ur: Usay baqi din ke liye khel se nikalein aur concussion ka assessment karein

feedback.en: Yes — if in doubt, sit them out; no same-day return.
feedback.ur: Haan — shak ho to bitha dein; usi din wapsi nahi.

text.en: Let him continue because he feels better
text.ur: Usay jaari rakhne dein kyunke woh behtar mehsoos karta hai

feedback.en: Symptoms can appear or worsen later.
feedback.ur: Alamaat baad mein zahir ya barh sakti hain.

text.en: Return him after a 15-minute rest if he passes a quick test
text.ur: Agar woh jaldi wala test pass kare to 15 minute aaram ke baad wapas laayein

feedback.en: A suspected concussion means no same-day return.
feedback.ur: Mashkook concussion ka matlab usi din wapsi nahi.

title.ur: Concussion ki alamaat ya red flags?

rows.en: Mild to moderate, eases with rest
rows.ur: Halka se darmiyana, aaram se kam
Thori madhoshi ya hosh nahi khoya

rows.en: Repeated vomiting, neck pain, increasing confusion or agitation
rows.ur: Bar bar ulti, gardan dard, barhti uljhan ya bechaini

text.en: **Recognise, remove, refer, return gradually.** The four R's keep the player safe from the field to the next match.
text.ur: **Pehchanein, nikalein, refer karein, aahista wapas laayein.** Chaar baatein khilari ko maidan se agle match tak mehfooz rakhti hain.

text.en: **Strict dark-room rest for weeks.** Long, complete rest is no longer advised: it can prolong symptoms and low mood. After the first 24 to 48 hours, light activity that does not clearly worsen symptoms, and a gradual return to school or work, help recovery.
text.ur: **Hafton tak sakht andhere kamre ka aaram.** Lamba, mukammal aaram ab tajweez nahi: yeh alamaat aur udasi ko lamba kar sakta hai. Pehle 24 se 48 ghante ke baad halki activity jo alamaat ko wazeh na barhaye, aur school ya kaam par aahista wapsi recovery mein madad deti hai.

question.en: Which sign after a head injury needs emergency hospital care?
question.ur: Sar ki chot ke baad kaun si nishani emergency hospital care maangti hai?

text.en: Repeated vomiting and a worsening headache
text.ur: Bar bar ulti aur barhta sar dard

feedback.en: Yes — these can signal bleeding or swelling in the brain.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh dimagh mein bleeding ya sujan ka ishara ho sakte hain.

feedback.en: That is a common, usual symptom.
feedback.ur: Yeh aam, mamool ki alamat hai.

question.en: Why must a player never return on the same day after a suspected concussion?
question.ur: Mashkook concussion ke baad khilari usi din kabhi wapas kyun nahi aana chahiye?

text.en: It is only a rule for professional players
text.ur: Yeh sirf professional khilariyon ka usool hai

feedback.en: It applies to everyone, especially children.
feedback.ur: Yeh sab par lagu hota hai, khaas taur par bachon par.

text.en: A scan the same day always shows the injury
text.ur: Usi din ka scan hamesha chot dikhata hai

feedback.en: Concussion usually does not show on scans.
feedback.ur: Concussion aam taur par scans mein nazar nahi aata.

text.en: Symptoms can be delayed, and a second blow to a recovering brain can cause serious harm
text.ur: Alamaat der se aa sakti hain, aur theek hote dimagh par doosri chot sangeen nuqsan kar sakti hai

feedback.en: Yes — that is why the rule has no exceptions.
feedback.ur: Haan — isi liye is usool mein koi chhoot nahi.

text.en: **Teach the family what to watch for.** Give written advice on the red flags, ask that someone stays with the player for the first night, and avoid alcohol and driving until symptoms settle. Plan the return to school or work with the teacher or employer: shorter days and screen breaks first, then full days, before any return to contact sport.
text.ur: **Ghar walon ko sikhayein kis cheez par nazar rakhni hai.** Red flags ka likha hua mashwara dein, kahein ke pehli raat koi khilari ke saath rahe, aur alamaat theek hone tak sharab aur gaari chalane se bachein. School ya kaam par wapsi teacher ya employer ke saath plan karein: pehle chhote din aur screen se waqfa, phir poore din, kisi bhi contact sport mein wapsi se pehle.

question.en: Why are children and teenagers managed more cautiously?
question.ur: Bachon aur nojawanon ka intezam zyada ehtiyat se kyun kiya jata hai?

answer.en: The developing brain may take longer to recover, symptoms can last longer, and school learning is easily affected. Guidelines advise return to learning first, a slower graded return to sport, and medical clearance before contact, so their return usually takes longer than an adult's.
answer.ur: Barhta hua dimagh theek hone mein zyada waqt le sakta hai, alamaat lambi chal sakti hain, aur school ki parhai aasani se mutasir hoti hai. Guidelines pehle parhai mein wapsi, khel mein aahista darje war wapsi, aur contact se pehle medical ijazat ka mashwara deti hain, is liye un ki wapsi aam taur par baalighon se lambi hoti hai.

beats.patient: A 16-year-old footballer heads the ball awkwardly and clashes with another player. He is dazed, slow to get up and complains of headache and feeling "foggy". He has no vomiting, weakness or neck pain.
beats.assessment: He has a suspected concussion without red flags.
beats.treatment: Remove him from play, do not allow return that day, give written red-flag advice to his parents, then after 24 to 48 hours start symptom-limited activity, return to school with breaks, and follow the graded return to sport with medical clearance before contact.
beats.reassess: His symptoms settle over 10 days; he returns to school in week one and to full matches about 3 weeks after the injury.

text.en: **Call an ambulance or go to the emergency department** for loss of consciousness, a seizure, deteriorating consciousness, severe or worsening headache, repeated vomiting, double vision, weakness or tingling in the arms or legs, neck pain or tenderness (protect the neck), or increasing confusion, restlessness or agitation. **Never allow same-day return** after a suspected concussion.
text.ur: **Ambulance bulayein ya emergency department jayein** hosh khone, daure, girte hue hosh, shadeed ya barhte sar dard, bar bar ulti, double nazar, bazuon ya taangon mein kamzori ya jhunjhunahat, gardan mein dard ya chhoone par dard (gardan ki hifazat karein), ya barhti uljhan, bechaini ya ghusse par. Mashkook concussion ke baad **usi din wapsi ki kabhi ijazat na dein**.

summary.en: Concussion is a brain injury that usually does not show on scans; "if in doubt, sit them out", with no same-day return.
summary.ur: Concussion dimagh ki chot hai jo aam taur par scans mein nazar nahi aati; "shak ho to bitha dein", usi din wapsi nahi.

summary.en: Red flags (worsening headache, repeated vomiting, seizure, weakness, neck pain, deteriorating consciousness) need emergency care.
summary.ur: Red flags (barhta sar dard, bar bar ulti, daura, kamzori, gardan dard, girta hosh) ko emergency care chahiye.

summary.en: After 24 to 48 hours of relative rest, return gradually: symptom-limited activity, aerobic, sport-specific, non-contact, full-contact, then play — school before sport.
summary.ur: 24 se 48 ghante ke nisbatan aaram ke baad aahista wapsi: alamaat tak mehdood activity, aerobic, khel ki khaas, non-contact, full-contact, phir match — khel se pehle school.

front.en: Can a concussed player return the same day?
front.ur: Kya concussion wala khilari usi din wapas aa sakta hai?

back.en: Never — if in doubt, sit them out.
back.ur: Kabhi nahi — shak ho to bitha dein.

front.en: Does concussion show on a CT scan?
front.ur: Kya concussion CT scan mein nazar aata hai?

back.en: Usually not; it is a functional brain injury.
back.ur: Aam taur par nahi; yeh dimagh ki functional chot hai.

front.en: How long is each step of the graded return?
front.ur: Darje war wapsi ka har qadam kitna lamba hai?

back.en: Usually at least 24 hours per step.
back.ur: Aam taur par har qadam kam az kam 24 ghante.

front.ur: Concussion ke teen red flags batayein.

back.en: Worsening headache, repeated vomiting, seizure (also weakness, neck pain, deteriorating consciousness).
back.ur: Barhta sar dard, bar bar ulti, daura (aur kamzori, gardan dard, girta hosh).

note.en: The first five minutes when a patient is suddenly unwell.
note.ur: Mareez ke achanak bigarne par pehle paanch minute.
